_meta.source: classify-building workflow wf_ff745c67-0bf (14 agents, adversarially verified)
_meta.note: Per-field dispositions for #428 migration. FIRST-PASS classification: owner rules on shape + shoehorn/drop candidates BEFORE curate_building.py is authored. Owner ruling: trust nothing in building data (biggest creative-mechanics target); willing to DROP too-insane / extensively-shoehorning mechanics case-by-case.

fields.name: YieldChanges
fields.consumers: CvCity::processBuilding(4667 changeBuildingExtraYield100), CvGameTextMgr pedia, Python TestCode/Advisors
fields.notes: Base city yields from the building. Split into food/production/commerce per modifier-spec §2 (the split-families rule); city scope.

fields.name: YieldModifiers
fields.notes: Percentage modifiers on city yields; city scope. Summed with other percent sources per family combine rules (§2).

fields.name: YieldPerPopChanges
fields.consumers: CvCity::changeBaseYieldPerPopRate (4669), city per-pop yield rate reader
fields.notes: Per-capita yields (bonus per city population): food/production/commerce added per population unit. Uses `per` count-scaler (modifier-spec §4).

fields.name: RiverPlotYieldChanges
fields.notes: River-plot-specific yields: building owns this modifier keyed by plot, gated by HAS_RIVER (enabler-spec §3, modifier-spec §6.1 deliveryguy). Lands on building, not on terrain.

fields.name: PowerYieldModifiers
fields.notes: VERIFIER: Yield % bonuses conditional on power. Gated by the `HAS_POWER` boolean predicate (modifier-spec §3 bare-string form); city scope.

fields.name: AreaYieldModifiers
fields.consumers: CvPlayer::changeYieldRateModifier on pArea (CvPlayer.cpp:7453 pArea->changeYieldRateModifier), area-wide yield %
fields.notes: VERIFIER: Yield % bonuses at area (continent) scope. Affects all cities in the area. Consumer was listed as 'No files found' in prior grep but exists at CvPlayer.cpp:7453; verified live.

fields.name: GlobalYieldModifiers
fields.notes: Yield % bonuses at empire (player/all-cities) scope. Affects the player's all cities. Via CvPlayer's additive accumulator.

fields.name: GlobalSeaPlotYieldChanges
fields.notes: Sea-plot (water tile) yields; global effect via all sea-plots owned. Building delivers this modifier plot-keyed, gated by water check.

fields.name: PlotYieldChanges
fields.consumers: CvCity::changePlotYieldChanges (4993, called via processBuilding 4985 foreach getPlotYieldChanges), plot yield reader
fields.notes: VERIFIER: LIVE, NOT DEAD. Generic plot yields keyed by PlotType (not river-gated like RiverPlotYieldChanges). Consumed at CvCity.cpp:4985 in processBuilding loop over building's plot yield changes.

fields.name: CommerceChanges
fields.notes: Base city commerce adds, split into gold/research/culture/espionage per modifier-spec §2. City scope.

fields.name: CommerceModifiers
fields.notes: Commerce % modifiers at city scope. Summed with other percent sources per family combine (additive deltas).

fields.name: CommercePerPopChanges
fields.consumers: CvCity::changeCommercePerPopFromBuildings (4681, via per-pop rate accumulator), city per-pop commerce reader
fields.notes: Per-capita commerce (bonus per city population). Uses `per` count-scaler (modifier-spec §4, like YieldPerPopChanges).

fields.name: CommerceChangeDoubleTimes
fields.consumers: CvCity::getBaseCommerceRateFromBuilding100 (12197-12203 post-sum ×2 path via iTimeBuilt check), Python TestCode
fields.notes: VERIFIER: CRITICAL MECHANIC — age-gated temporal doubling. Building outputs DOUBLE commerce after existing ≥N turns (CvCity.cpp:12197-12203 reads getCommerceChangeDoubleTime + created-timestamp). Author as a SECOND conditional deposit with `enabled:{existedFor:{min:iDoubleTime}}`, never as a separate 'doubleTime' magnitude field.

fields.name: GlobalCommerceModifiers
fields.notes: Commerce % modifiers at empire (player) scope. Affects all of player's cities via CvPlayer's additive accumulator.

fields.name: StateReligionCommerces
fields.consumers: CvCity::getBaseCommerceRateFromBuilding100 (12178-12180 checks getStateReligion match), empire state-religion-gated commerce reader
fields.notes: VERIFIER: CONSUMER CORRECTED — CvCity.cpp:12179 checks if building's ReligionType == player.getStateReligion(), then adds pOwner->getStateReligionBuildingCommerce(). Per-commerce-type array; not a per-religion modifier, but a per-commerce flat conditional on the BUILDING's religion being the current state religion.

fields.name: CommerceHappinesses
fields.notes: INVERSE family: happiness produced per unit of each commerce type (a per-commerce-type array). Building declares happiness GAINED per commerce produced (each gold yields X happiness). Lands in `happiness` family with per-commerce-type key.

fields.name: CommerceFlexibles
fields.consumers: CvPlayer::changeCommerceFlexibleCount (7470), CvTeam::getCommerceFlexible (flexibility query), flexibility check reader
fields.notes: NOT a modifier: a per-commerce-type boolean flag indicating which commerce types CAN SLIDE (trade-route flexibility). Parked in `cost` section as a behavioral boolean property, keyed by commerce type.

fields.name: GlobalReligionCommerce
fields.notes: VERIFIER: DELIVERYGUY + WORLD SCALING. Building holds a SINGLE RELIGION TYPE enum (m_iGlobalReligionCommerce, FK). Commerce is per-type. Scaled by world religion count of that specific religion: value × countReligionLevels(religion). Store this as `shrine` module (dedicated block per §0.8) keyed by the religion type, per-commerce-type.

fields.name: SpecialistYieldChanges
fields.consumers: CvCity::changeSpecialistTotal (5143 changeSpecialistYieldTotal + player %adjustments), specialist-keyed yield reader
fields.notes: Yields produced by specialists WHEN PLACED in this building. Keyed by specialist type (2D: specialist×yield). Specialist scope — lands on specialist's modifiers, authored on building.

fields.name: SpecialistCommerceChanges
fields.consumers: CvCity::processSpecialist (5148-5157 getCommerceChange, commented—pending TB float adjustment), specialist-keyed commerce reader
fields.notes: Commerce produced by specialists WHEN PLACED in this building. Keyed by specialist type (2D: specialist×commerce). Specialist scope. Currently commented (TB mod pending float adjustment), but code structure is clear; KEEP.

fields.name: LocalSpecialistCommerceChanges
fields.notes: BONUS commerce for specialists IN THIS CITY (per-specialist-type, local to the building's city, not global). Keyed by specialist type. City scope with specialist sub-key.

fields.name: SpecialistExtraCommerces
fields.notes: EMPIRE-wide bonus commerce on specialists (per-commerce-type, not specialist-keyed). Applied to all specialists of all types across the empire. Empire scope.

fields.name: iHealth
fields.consumers: CvCity processBuilding via changeBuildingGoodHealth / changeBuildingBadHealth (CvCity.cpp:4633-4637); AI valuation (CvCityAI.cpp:1949-1952); GUI filter (CvBuildingFilters.cpp:96)
fields.notes: City-scoped per-turn health deposit (positive=good, negative=bad); legacy split into two accumulators via the getHealth()>0 polarity check.

fields.name: iAreaHealth
fields.consumers: CvCity processBuilding via area()-level health (CvCity.cpp:4634-4636); AI valuation (CvCityAI.cpp:1954); GUI filter (CvBuildingFilters.cpp:97)
fields.notes: Area-scoped health bonus to all cities in the area. Scope is area, not city.

fields.name: iGlobalHealth
fields.consumers: CvCity processBuilding via player-level health (CvCity.cpp:4637-4639); AI valuation (CvCityAI.cpp:1955); GUI filter (CvBuildingFilters.cpp:98)
fields.notes: Empire-scoped health to all player cities. Applied globally, not per-city.

fields.name: iHappiness
fields.consumers: CvCity processBuilding via changeBuildingGoodHappiness / changeBuildingBadHappiness (CvCity.cpp:4640-4644); pedia (CvGameTextMgr.cpp); AI (CvCityAI.cpp:1946-1948)
fields.notes: City-scoped per-turn happiness (positive=good, negative=bad); legacy split via the >0 polarity check into good/bad pools.

fields.name: iAreaHappiness
fields.consumers: CvCity processBuilding for area-level happiness; AI valuation (CvCityAI.cpp:1953)
fields.notes: Area-scoped happiness bonus to all cities in the area.

fields.name: iGlobalHappiness
fields.consumers: CvCity processBuilding for empire-level happiness; AI valuation (CvCityAI.cpp:1955); GUI filter (CvBuildingFilters.cpp:99)
fields.notes: Empire-scoped happiness to all player cities. Applies globally.

fields.name: iStateReligionHappiness
fields.notes: Happiness conditional on state religion. Authored as happiness.city.flat with enabled:{STATE_RELIGION:religion} predicate (owner 2026-06-15, per enabler-spec §3).

fields.name: iHealRateChange
fields.consumers: CvCity processBuilding via changeHealRate (CvCity.cpp:4630); AI valuation (CvCityAI.cpp:1963)
fields.notes: Per-turn healing rate added to the city's unit-healing pool; author as flat amount in a dedicated healing family.

fields.name: iFoodKept
fields.consumers: CvCity processBuilding via changeFoodKeptPercent (CvCity.cpp:4621); AI valuation (CvCityAI.cpp:1962,1984); food calc (CvCity.cpp:10359)
fields.notes: Percentage of surplus food retained on growth (getFoodKeptPercent → stored-away food scaling). Unit is percent, not flat.

fields.name: iGreatPeopleRateChange
fields.consumers: CvCity processBuilding via changeBaseGreatPeopleRate + per-unit type (CvCity.cpp:4663-4668); AI valuation (CvCityAI.cpp:1968); pedia
fields.notes: Per-turn great-people rate bonus to a city (or routed to specific unit type via specialist logic).

fields.name: iGreatPeopleRateModifier
fields.notes: Multiplicative modifier on the city's great-people rate (percent, additive across sources).

fields.name: iGreatGeneralRateModifier
fields.consumers: AI valuation (CvCityAI.cpp trait/civic pedia); pedia (CvGameTextMgr.cpp:12041-12043); Trait/Civic reading
fields.notes: Modifier on great-general production rate at city scope (unit only).

fields.name: iDomesticGreatGeneralRateModifier
fields.notes: Modifier on domestic (own-produced) great-general rate; distinguished from global modifier.

fields.name: iGlobalGreatPeopleRateModifier
fields.notes: Empire-wide modifier on all cities' great-people rates.

fields.name: iMaintenanceModifier
fields.consumers: CvCity getMaintenanceModifier (CvCity.cpp:4681); CvArea getTotalAreaMaintenanceModifier; AI valuation (CvCityAI.cpp:1956,1981,1988); pedia
fields.notes: City-scoped maintenance cost modifier (cost-style, multiplicative with other mods).

fields.name: iGlobalMaintenanceModifier
fields.notes: Empire-wide maintenance cost modifier applied to all player cities.

fields.name: iAreaMaintenanceModifier
fields.notes: Area-scoped maintenance modifier applied to all cities in the area.

fields.name: iOtherAreaMaintenanceModifier
fields.consumers: CvArea getTotalAreaMaintenanceModifier (CvArea.cpp:2001) — applied to OTHER areas
fields.notes: Creative: a building in one area buffs maintenance in OTHER areas (non-home area). Named distinctly from iAreaMaintenanceModifier.

fields.name: iDistanceMaintenanceModifier
fields.notes: Modifier on the distance-based maintenance component (empire-wide, affects cost formula).

fields.name: iNumCitiesMaintenanceModifier
fields.consumers: Mapping file indicates it exists; no explicit reader found in search, but per-city count maintenance is a documented mechanic.
fields.notes: Modifier on the per-city-count maintenance cost component (empire scope). Part of the maintenance family structure (§7).

fields.name: iCoastalDistanceMaintenanceModifier
fields.consumers: Mapping file lists it; the coastal-distance maintenance variant of distance-maintenance.
fields.notes: Modifier on coastal-variant distance maintenance (empire scope). Sub-member within the maintenance family.

fields.name: iConnectedCityMaintenanceModifier
fields.consumers: Mapping file lists it; part of the connected-city maintenance calculation.
fields.notes: Modifier on maintenance for connected cities (empire scope, per-city connectivity variant).

fields.name: iInflationModifier
fields.consumers: VERIFIER: CvPlayer::changeBuildingInflation (CvPlayer.cpp:7398) consumes this on empire; Tech/Project/Event also have inflation modifiers; NOT dead.
fields.notes: Inflation modifier (empire-wide). Live empire-scope modifier consumed during building processBuilding on the player.

fields.name: iWarWearinessModifier
fields.consumers: CvCity getWarWearinessModifier (CvCity.cpp:4682); anger calc (CvCity.cpp:9024); AI valuation (CvCityAI.cpp:1980,1982,1987)
fields.notes: City-scoped war-weariness modifier; affects how quickly war increases anger (cost-style multiplication).

fields.name: iGlobalWarWearinessModifier
fields.consumers: CvCity getWarWearinessModifier (CvCity.cpp:4682) as global component; AI valuation (CvCityAI.cpp:1982,1987)
fields.notes: Empire-wide war-weariness modifier; applied to all player cities.

fields.name: iEnemyWarWearinessModifier
fields.notes: Creative: a building inflicts war weariness on enemies (enemy-directed, not self-targeted). City-scoped effect on enemy morale.

fields.name: iHurryCostModifier
fields.consumers: CvCity getHurryCostModifier overloads (CvCity.cpp:10282-10311); AI valuation; pedia
fields.notes: City-scoped modifier on the cost of rushing production (both gold-rush and pop-rush). Affects hurry cost calculation.

fields.name: iGlobalHurryModifier
fields.notes: Empire-wide modifier on hurry cost (affects all player's hurry operations).

fields.name: iHurryAngerModifier
fields.notes: City-scoped modifier on anger inflicted by rushing (reduces/increases hurry-anger).

fields.name: iMilitaryProductionModifier
fields.notes: City-scoped modifier on military unit production hammers.

fields.name: iSpaceProductionModifier
fields.notes: City-scoped modifier on space-race project production.

fields.name: iGlobalSpaceProductionModifier
fields.notes: Empire-wide modifier on all player's space-production.

fields.name: iWorkerSpeedModifier
fields.notes: Empire-wide worker-speed modifier (affects worker build-time). Named 'workRate' family per modifier-spec (relates to worker capacity/build-time system).

fields.name: iTradeRoutes
fields.notes: City-scoped count of trade routes granted by this building (flat amount, not modifier).

fields.name: iCoastalTradeRoutes
fields.consumers: VERIFIER: CvPlayer::changeCoastalTradeRoutes (CvPlayer.cpp:7393); AI valuation (CvCityAI.cpp:2065); consumed at PLAYER level, not city.
fields.notes: VERIFIER: Scope is EMPIRE not city; building's coastal routes are accumulated on CvPlayer via processBuilding, not on cities.

fields.name: iGlobalTradeRoutes
fields.consumers: CvCity getTradeRoutes (CvCity.cpp:10340) adds player-level routes; AI valuation (CvCityAI.cpp:2065)
fields.notes: Empire-wide trade routes granted to the entire player (applies to every city).

fields.name: iWorldTradeRoutes
fields.consumers: CvCity getTradeRoutes (CvCity.cpp:10339) adds game-global routes; pedia
fields.notes: World-scope trade routes (applied to all players' cities). Distinct from empire-scope.

fields.name: iTradeRouteModifier
fields.notes: City-scoped modifier on the yield from trade routes (multiplicative on trade route output).

fields.name: iForeignTradeRouteModifier
fields.notes: Creative: building-level modifier specifically for FOREIGN trade routes (internal vs external trade distinction).

fields.name: iFreeExperience
fields.consumers: CvCity processBuilding (adds to military units directly, keyed by UnitCombat); AI (CvCityAI.cpp:1956)
fields.notes: City-scoped free experience granted to units trained in the city. Author as experience deposit on building keyed by city.

fields.name: iGlobalFreeExperience
fields.consumers: CvCity processBuilding for empire-level experience; pedia
fields.notes: Empire-wide free experience for all player units.

fields.name: iFreeSpecialist
fields.consumers: CvCity processBuilding via changeFreeSpecialistCount (mapping: iExperience → experience, iFreeSpecialist distinct); AI valuation
fields.notes: City-scoped count of free specialist slots granted by the building.

fields.name: iAreaFreeSpecialist
fields.consumers: CvCity processBuilding for area-level specialists; mapping file lists it (iAreaFreeSpecialist → freeSpecialists.area.flat)
fields.notes: Area-scoped free specialists to all cities in the area.

fields.name: iGlobalFreeSpecialist
fields.consumers: CvCity processBuilding for player-level specialists; AI (CvCityAI.cpp:1956); pedia
fields.notes: Empire-wide free specialists granted to all player cities.

fields.name: iAnarchyModifier
fields.consumers: AI valuation (CvCityAI.cpp:1991); pedia; anarchy duration mechanics
fields.notes: City-scoped modifier on anarchy duration (reduces/increases revolution-period length).

fields.name: iGoldenAgeModifier
fields.notes: Empire-wide modifier on golden-age duration or effectiveness.

fields.name: iOccupationTimeModifier
fields.notes: City-scoped modifier on occupation time (how long enemy-captured cities remain unhappy/undefended).

fields.name: iPopulationgrowthratepercentage
fields.notes: City-scoped modifier on the city's population growth rate (percent, affects food-to-grow threshold).

fields.name: iGlobalPopulationgrowthratepercentage
fields.notes: Empire-wide population growth rate modifier (applies to all player cities).

fields.name: iHealthPercentPerPopulation
fields.notes: City-scoped health that scales with population (health = iHealthPercentPerPopulation × population / 100).

fields.name: iHappinessPercentPerPopulation
fields.notes: City-scoped happiness that scales with population (happiness = iHappinessPercentPerPopulation × population / 100).

fields.name: iRevIdxLocal
fields.notes: City-scoped revolution index flat bonus/penalty. Part of the revolution/anarchy system.

fields.name: iRevIdxNational
fields.notes: Empire-wide revolution index bonus (affects national revolution threshold).

fields.name: iRevIdxDistanceModifier
fields.notes: Creative: distance-based modifier on revolution index (scales with distance from capital). Author as a distance-dependent modifier on revolution.

fields.name: iPillageGoldModifier
fields.consumers: No C++ consumer found in grep (not in CvBuildingInfo.cpp reader output). Mapping file does not list it (likely dropped/unwired).
fields.notes: §8-ii UNWIRED MODIFIER: intended mechanic (empire-level pillage-gold boost) is not wired in C++. REVIVE as pillageGold.empire.percent (intended use: world wonder amplifying empire pillage income).

fields.name: iInsidiousness
fields.notes: Creative: espionage insidiousness metric (affects city vulnerability to spy action). Author in espionage family (part of the espionage subsystem).

fields.name: iInvestigation
fields.notes: Creative: espionage investigation metric (counter to insidiousness, defender mechanic). Author in espionage family.

fields.name: iNationalCaptureProbabilityModifier
fields.notes: Creative: empire-scope modifier on the probability of capturing cities (gradient mechanic, per modifier-spec §5). Author under capture family as a probability modifier.

fields.name: iNationalCaptureResistanceModifier
fields.notes: Creative: empire-scope defensive modifier against capture (counter to probability). Author under capture family.

fields.name: iLocalCaptureProbabilityModifier
fields.notes: Creative: city-scope modifier on capture probability (local/tactical variant). Author under capture family.

fields.name: iLocalCaptureResistanceModifier
fields.notes: Creative: city-scope defensive modifier against capture. Author under capture family.

fields.name: iUnitUpgradePriceModifier
fields.consumers: AI / pedia reading of Trait/Civic via getUnitUpgradePriceModifier (CvGameTextMgr.cpp:12043); no Building-specific consumer found in City/CityAI
fields.notes: Empire-wide modifier on unit upgrade cost. Likely no Building-direct consumer (may be triggered via trait/civic only).

fields.name: iDefenseModifier
fields.consumers: CvCity::getDefenseModifier (CvCity.h:175), CvCity.cpp:4767-4768 applies to getTotalDefense; CvGameTextMgr:15844-15847; CyCity.h Python binding
fields.notes: City tile defense % boost. Verified all consumers apply multiplicatively as documented in modifier-spec §2 family arithmetic.

fields.name: iBombardDefenseModifier
fields.consumers: CvCity::getBombardDefense (CvCity.h:176), reads at CvCity.cpp:9947-9950 clamp logic; CvGameTextMgr:15868-15870; Python binding
fields.notes: VERIFIER: The getter name is `getBombardDefenseModifier` not `getBuildingBombardDefense`; specialized defense channel member distinct from general amount.

fields.name: iAllCityDefenseModifier
fields.consumers: CvCity::getAllCityDefenseModifier (CvCity.h:177), applied at CvCity.cpp:4768 to city; scope empire per store.PLAYER_WIDE_MODIFIERS; CvCityAI:5373 AI values it; CvGameTextMgr pedia
fields.notes: VERIFIER: Verified as `iAllCityDefenseModifier` applied to ALL cities (empire scope), not per-building-authored keyed modifiers; modifier-spec §6.1 confirmed as deliveryguy-owned (keep-on-building).

fields.name: iEspionageDefenseModifier
fields.consumers: CvCity::getEspionageDefense (CvCity.h:178), accumulated at CvCity.cpp:14241; CvGameTextMgr:16482-16484 pedia; Python binding
fields.notes: City espionage defense flat amount. Different system/channel from combat defense (separate modifier family per spec §0.8).

fields.name: iNukeModifier
fields.consumers: CvCity::getNukeModifier (CvCity.h:123 wrongly named, actually nuke defense), applied in CvCity.cpp combat nuke-defense; CvGameTextMgr:15875-15877; AI threat assessments
fields.notes: Nuke defense reduction %. Family member parallel to bombardDefense. Getter name in header misleading (getNukeModifier) but it's nuke defense per CvCity logic.

fields.name: iAirModifier
fields.consumers: CvCity::getAirModifier (CvCity.h:121), reads at CvCity.cpp air-attack defense logic; CvGameTextMgr:16477-16479 pedia; AI city defense evals
fields.notes: Air defense % boost for defending against air attacks. Parallel family member to bombardDefense.

fields.name: iAirlift
fields.consumers: CvCity::getAirlift (CvCity.h:120, CvCity.cpp:4740 explicit setter), mission-system checks airlift FROM this city; CvUnit mission logic; CyCity Python binding
fields.notes: Airlift capacity count (not additive modifier). Belongs to identity (lookup/override property per modifier-spec §7), not cascade.

fields.name: iAirUnitCapacity
fields.consumers: CvCity::getAirUnitCapacity (CvCity.h:122, read in air-unit basing logic CvCity.cpp:5046), AI placement decisions CvCityAI:5433; capacity for air units to base here
fields.notes: Air unit basing capacity count (not modifier). Identity property (REPLACE/SET non-additive override).

fields.name: iMinDefense
fields.consumers: CvCity::setMinimumDefenseLevel (CvCity.cpp:4776, 4880-4883 sets override), reads in getTotalDefense clamp CvCity.cpp:4804; CvGameTextMgr:17792-17795; spec §7 'min' member
fields.notes: Defense clamp floor (minimum defense level). Per modifier-spec §7, family structure carries `min` member alongside `amount`.

fields.name: iNoEntryDefenseLevel
fields.consumers: CvCity::getNoEntryDefenseLevel (CvCity.cpp:695 derives m_iNoEntryDefenseLevel), gates unit ENTRY at CvCity.cpp:4813-4839 combat checks; CvCityAI:5343, 13028; CvGameTextMgr:15861-15864
fields.notes: VERIFIER: Confirmed CREATIVE mechanic — a minimum defense that blocks unit ENTRY (not just reduction). Distinct from combat defense (defensive gate mechanic).

fields.name: iLocalDynamicDefense
fields.consumers: CvCity::getLocalDynamicDefense (CvCity.cpp:870 derives m_iLocalDynamicDefense), applied at CvCity.cpp:4770; CvCityAI:5356, 13041; CvGameTextMgr:17773-17776; filter CvBuildingFilters:279
fields.notes: VERIFIER: Confirmed CREATIVE — defense that scales with garrison strength (dynamic per occupant units). Non-obvious mechanic distinct from static defense.

fields.name: iRiverDefensePenalty
fields.consumers: CvCity::getRiverDefensePenalty (CvCity.cpp:875 derives m_iRiverDefensePenalty), applied at CvCity.cpp:4771 penalty when river present; CvCityAI:5360, 13045, 13067, 13650 evals; CvGameTextMgr:17780-17789 shows/negates; filter:289
fields.notes: Negative defense modifier on river tiles. Penalty flavor (may be negative flat value). Family member parallel to bombardDefense.

fields.name: iBuildingDefenseRecoverySpeedModifier
fields.consumers: CvCity::getBuildingDefenseRecoverySpeedModifier (CvCity.cpp:889 derives m_iBuildingDefenseRecoverySpeedModifier), applied at CvCity.cpp:4775 if >0 && DefenseModifier>0; CvCityAI:5362, 13047; CvGameTextMgr:17798-17807; filter:291
fields.notes: Building-contributed defense RECOVERY % per turn (damage heal rate). Percent modifier applied to per-turn recovery calculation.

fields.name: iCityDefenseRecoverySpeedModifier
fields.consumers: CvCity::getCityDefenseRecoverySpeedModifier (CvCity.cpp:894 derives m_iCityDefenseRecoverySpeedModifier), applied at CvCity.cpp:4778; CvCityAI:5363, 13048; CvGameTextMgr:17810-17819; filter:292
fields.notes: City-wide defense recovery % (scales per-turn heal). Family member parallel to buildingDefenseRecovery (two timescales: building-specific vs city-wide).

fields.name: iDamageAttackerChance
fields.consumers: CvCity::getDamageAttackerChance (CvCity.cpp:899 derives), checked in CvUnit.cpp:26620 RNG gate, CvCity.cpp:4780 applies; AI val CvCityAI:5376, 13060; CvGameTextMgr:15894, 15918, 29893-29915; filter:na
fields.notes: Chance % that building's counterattack damages attacker (flat % value, used in RNG percent check per CvUnit.cpp:26620). Not a modifier value but a probability gate.

fields.name: iDamageToAttacker
fields.consumers: CvCity::getDamageToAttacker (CvCity.cpp:904 derives), applied in CvUnit.cpp:26622 (iBuildingAttackDamageBase += ...); AI val CvCityAI:5376, 13060; CvGameTextMgr:15894, 15918, 29893-29915; pedia
fields.notes: Counterattack damage amount (flat, additive). Defense damage deposit (building-authored, deliveryguy-owned per §6.1).

fields.name: bDamageAllAttackers
fields.consumers: CvBuildingInfo::isDamageAttackerCapable (CvBuildingInfo.cpp:948, derives m_bDamageAttackerCapable), gates at CvCity.cpp:4709 (if isMayDamage...); CvCityAI:5374 filters; CvGameTextMgr:15887-15920 conditionally shows damage text
fields.notes: Boolean flag: building ENABLES damage-counterattack capability on city (not a modifier value, a capability gate). Grants as an enabler (capability boolean).

fields.name: iAdjacentDamagePercent
fields.consumers: CvCity::getAdjacentDamagePercent (CvCity.h:195), read in CvCity.cpp interception/nearby-combat logic; AI evals CvCityAI:na; CvGameTextMgr:na (pedia exists per mapping); used in adjacent unit attack math
fields.notes: Adjacent unit damage bonus %. Defense-adjacent mechanic: units next to the building deal extra damage (percent bonus).

fields.name: iLocalRepel
fields.consumers: CvCity::getLocalRepel (mapping says iLocalRepel), read in CvCity.cpp pathfinding/attack-deterrence; CvCityAI:5373 threat assessment; CvGameTextMgr:na; behavior-influence mechanic
fields.notes: VERIFIER: Confirmed CREATIVE — repel value (locally deters attacks via unit-behavior influence, not direct damage). Scope city (local repulsion from this city's defense).

fields.name: iLineOfSight
fields.consumers: CvCity::getLineOfSight (CvCity.h:193, read mapping says iLineOfSight), applied at CvCity.cpp:4739 (m_iLineOfSight *= iChange); vision system checks LOS from city; CvGameTextMgr pedia; Python
fields.notes: City vision range extension (flat amount). Not a modifier/cascade — sight is a visibility property (identity, no summation logic per spec §7).

fields.name: iNumUnitFullHeal
fields.consumers: CvCity::getNumUnitFullHeal (CvCity.h:205, read CvCity.cpp:4737, 21438-21449 healUnits applies), AI values it CvCityAI:6089, 13794; CvGameTextMgr:16429 pedia; Python
fields.notes: Count of units city can FULLY heal per turn (capability grant, count not modifier). Per-turn action pool (one-shot/per-turn, not continuous).

fields.name: iWorkableRadius
fields.consumers: CvCity::setWorkableRadiusOverride (CvCity.h:206, CvCity.cpp:4862-4865 reads iWorkableRadius, sets override), getWorkableRadiusOverride checks it; plot-work logic queries override; Python
